summary.en: A chapter turn: the number above, the title slams in decoded at 150 px, the card line types, then the title flies to the page header, motion-blurred, while the note slides in under it.
summary.zh: 章节转场：上方是章节号，标题以 150 px 解码砸入，卡片行敲出，然后标题带着运动模糊飞到页眉，注释从下面滑入。

fits: Each chapter of a phosphor film, before its page.
notFor: Films with one chapter (use the page alone, header decoding in); more than four chapters.

intent.en: Mark each chapter as a command the film is about to run: its name big, its tool in mono, then the name becomes the page's header.
intent.zh: 把每一章标成片子将要运行的一条命令：章名大字，工具名用等宽字，然后章名变成页眉。

content.en: Number and total, a title in two halves (≤ 2 words each), a card line (the chapter's tool, ≤ 6 words), a note for the page.
content.zh: 序号和总数、两半的标题（各 ≤ 4 字）、卡片行（本章用到的工具，≤ 24 字）、页面注释。

fits.zh: phosphor 片子每一章正文之前。

notFor.zh: 只有一章的片子（直接用正文页，页眉解码出现）；超过四章。

en: The page after it must draw the header in place (`headEnter: false`); the template starts the page 0.4 beat into the flight, the bricks after it.
zh: 之后的正文页要把页眉画在原位（headEnter: false）；模板在飞行进行到 0.4 拍时就开始正文，积木在飞行结束后才开始。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
